value.rationale: For a natural stochastic majority/tie-choice automaton introduced in 2026, the theorem reveals a genuinely hidden higher-order spatial dependency: every triple of outputs is indistinguishable from independent fair coins on the entire r=1/2 line, yet a fourth spin parity of magnitude (2p-1)^4/16 detects the dependence. The all-size stationarity rigidity and exactly characterized n=3/n=4 boundary eliminate large Markov matrices for this natural invariant-measure question. The output hierarchy is a useful exact diagnostic of local stochasticity, not merely a tiny numerical improvement or arbitrary parameter subset.
